name: UI：生图节点-字段配置验证(模型类型/Prompt/图片/比例/尺寸/输出模式)
description: 验证生图节点的6个配置字段完整性：模型类型(Select)、User Prompt(textarea变量引用)、输入图片(最多15张)、生图比例(Select)、图片尺寸(Select)、输出模式(Radio)

steps.description: 打开含生图节点的策略详情页
验证生图详情页已加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const allEls = document.querySelectorAll('*'); for (const el of allEls) { const t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); if (t === '生图' && el.children.length === 0) { const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) { el.click(); return { clicked: true, tag: el.tagName, rect: {x: rect.x, y: rect.y, w: rect.width, h: rect.height} }; } } } for (const el of allEls) { const t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); if (t.includes('生图') && el.children.length <= 2 && el.closest('[class*=node], [class*=Node], [class*=card], [class*=Card]')) { el.click(); return { clicked: true, tag: el.tagName }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 点击生图节点打开编辑抽屉

steps.label: image_gen-drawer-open
steps.description: 截图-生图节点编辑抽屉

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const text = drawer.textContent || ''; const fields = ['模型类型', 'User Prompt', '输入图片', '生图比例', '图片尺寸', '输出模式']; const fieldFound = fields.filter(f => text.includes(f)); const inputs = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio])')); const selects = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-select')); const textareas = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('textarea')); const radios = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper, input[type=radio]')); return { open: true, fieldCount: fieldFound.length, fields: fieldFound, inputCount: inputs.length, selectCount: selects.length, textareaCount: textareas.length, radioCount: radios.length, fullText: text.substring(0, 800) }; })()
steps.description: 分析生图节点表单结构
至少5个配置字段(模型类型/Prompt/输入图片/生图比例/图片尺寸/输出模式)

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const labels = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-label, label, .ant-descriptions-item-label')); const fieldMap = {}; for (const label of labels) { const text = (label.textContent || '').trim(); if (text.includes('模型类型')) fieldMap.modelType = true; if (text.includes('Prompt') || text.includes('prompt')) fieldMap.userPrompt = true; if (text.includes('输入图片') || text.includes('添加图片')) fieldMap.inputImages = true; if (text.includes('生图比例') || text.includes('比例')) fieldMap.aspectRatio = true; if (text.includes('图片尺寸') || text.includes('尺寸')) fieldMap.imageSize = true; if (text.includes('输出模式') || text.includes('输出')) fieldMap.outputMode = true; } return fieldMap; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const selects = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-select')); const selectLabels = selects.map(s => { const label = s.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent?.trim() || ''; return label; }); const textareas = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('textarea')); const textareaPlaceholders = textareas.map(t => t.getAttribute('placeholder') || ''); const radios = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper')); const radioLabels = radios.map(r => (r.textContent || '').trim()); return { selectLabels, textareaPlaceholders, radioLabels, selectCount: selects.length, textareaCount: textareas.length, radioCount: radios.length }; })()

steps.description: 至少3个Select下拉(模型类型/生图比例/图片尺寸)
至少2个Radio选项(输出模式:单图/打包)

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const addImgBtn = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('button, [role=button], span')).find(el => { const t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); return t.includes('添加图片') || t.includes('Add Image'); }); if (!addImgBtn) return { hasAddImageBtn: false }; const btnText = (addImgBtn.textContent || '').trim(); const maxMatch = btnText.match(/(\d+)\/(\d+)/); return { hasAddImageBtn: true, btnText, maxImages: maxMatch ? parseInt(maxMatch[2]) : null, currentImages: maxMatch ? parseInt(maxMatch[1]) : null }; })()
steps.description: 验证添加图片按钮及最大数量(0/15)

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { open: false }; const inputs = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]), textarea')); const filledInputs = {}; for (const inp of inputs) { const label = (inp.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').trim(); if (label.includes('seller')) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'test_seller_001'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); filledInputs.seller_id = 'test_seller_001'; } } return { open: true, filledInputs }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { ok: false }; const btns = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')); const runBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '运行' || t === '开始运行' || t.includes('运行'); }); if (runBtn && !runBtn.disabled) { runBtn.click(); return { ok: true }; } return { ok: false }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (modal) { const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-close'); if (closeBtn) closeBtn.click(); } return { closed: true }; })()

steps.description: 等待弹窗关闭和状态更新

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const resultBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '查看运行结果'; }); if (resultBtn) { resultBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

steps.description: 等待运行结果页面加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const text = document.body.innerText || ''; const hasResult = text.includes('运行结果') || text.includes('成功') || text.includes('完成') || text.includes('输出') || text.includes('试运行') || text.includes('策略'); const hasError = text.includes('失败') || text.includes('错误'); const hasLoading = text.includes('运行中') || !!document.querySelector('.ant-spin-spinning'); const urls = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"']+(?:\.jpg|\.png|\.webp|\.jpeg)/gi) || []; const allUrls = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<]+/gi) || []; return { hasLoading, hasResult, hasError, imageUrlCount: urls.length, allUrlCount: allUrls.length, textPreview: text.substring(0, 200) }; })()

steps.label: image_gen-config-done
steps.description: 生图节点字段配置验证完成截图

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在含生图节点的策略(10602)
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 生图节点6字段: 模型类型(Select必填)/User Prompt(textarea变量引用必填)/输入图片(添加图片最多15张)/生图比例(Select默认3:4)/图片尺寸(Select默认1K)/输出模式(Radio:拆分成单图给下游默认/多张图打包在一起)
riskPoints: 模型类型Select下拉选项是否正确加载
User Prompt textarea是否支持变量插入
添加图片上限15是否正确显示
生图比例默认值是否为3:4
图片尺寸默认值是否为1K
输出模式Radio默认选中'拆分成单图给下游'
